entries.06d0f30ab83315c3: Its strength is that it entered the job support market for technical college students ahead of competitors and has built close networks and cooperative relationships with teachers at technical colleges. Job-hunting events are sometimes held as part of school events or classes, and through a system in which the group works with teachers to handle everything from confirming attendance on the day to arranging transportation to the venue through a travel agency, it realizes events with a high participation rate among technical college students. Through its official guidebook, which delivers company information in advance, and "Kosen Plus," it also provides a system that enables both students and companies to efficiently gather information and make contact.
entries.07d896e1f1ff865b: Its main customers are companies in manufacturing, information and communications, construction, and other industries that are recruiting technical college students, and technical colleges and universities that commission the operation of job-hunting events. In the WEB content services business, it undertakes production on commission from corporate customers.

entries.0cdcbaa7a45264f0: It hosts the job-hunting event for technical college students, the 'Job Research Seminar for Technical College Students,' in 7 districts nationwide, and also undertakes the operation of school-hosted events on commission, operates the career support information site 'Kosen Plus,' and conducts recruitment consulting. Together with its consolidated subsidiary Adwill, it also produces WEB sites and videos for corporations.
entries.13960dec114600fd: It holds industry seminars specializing in science and engineering several times a year in major cities such as Tokyo and Osaka, providing opportunities to match mainly students from regional science and engineering universities with companies headquartered in major cities, and receives exhibition fees from companies. When it is contracted to run job-hunting events conducted by individual universities, it receives operating fees from the universities. It also holds career exchange meetings open only to female science and engineering students.

entries.2f31f74a1d5c5bfe: It sets forth the management philosophy "Flatten the world with innovation and innovative human resources" and makes it its mission to create a society in which job hunting does not depend on economic trends or companies' hiring environments. In its medium- to long-term management strategy, it makes focusing on career support for technical college students and expanding WEB content services its priority measures. For career support for technical college students, centered on job-hunting events for the 58 technical colleges nationwide and the career support information site "Kosen Plus," and the year-round accompanying "Kosen Human Resources Recruitment Project," it will also promote holding seminars themed on growth industries such as semiconductors and the defense industry. In WEB content services, it has launched "Direct Recruitment," a service that visualizes companies' appeal and leads directly to recruitment, and its policy is to develop it into a new growth driver through synergies and cross-selling with the career support business.

entries.72dd4b9e9c155135: Of net sales of ¥1,633 million for the fiscal year ended July 2026, the career support business accounted for ¥1,373 million, most of the total, and the WEB content services business accounted for ¥260 million. The group states that, as a leading company in the field of job hunting for technical college students, it aims to sustain high growth through expanding sales of related businesses. In the human resources and job support industry, demand for securing human resources is expected over the medium to long term against the background of a decline in the working-age population due to the declining birthrate and aging population, and demand for science and engineering and technical professionals in particular is explained to be remaining firm.
